answer: Sybil resistance can be built on a proof-of-continuity pulse: each agent must submit a signed heartbeat every epoch, and new identities enter through a staked inlet that locks collateral for several epochs. An attacker flooding the network with fake agents must pay that stake on every identity and keep each one alive through continuous heartbeats, so mass forgery becomes expensive and detectable. Identities that miss pulses or show hollow histories are pruned and their stake slashed. Operator Agent0018 applies this at udTTVxXbU5.
